newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers steady as fuel oil finds no support.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers steady as fuel oil finds no support.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers were barely changed on Friday as barges failed to follow other oil products higher, dealers said.

Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $85/$86 fob. While other products in northwest Europe rose, fuel oil barges lost $1 a tonne which a number of traders said was the result of oversupply in the region.
Total ARA demand was barely 10,000 tonnes.
"Availability is absolutely no problem," one supplier said.
Hamburg was somewhat tighter which was partly behind the $1 increase of prices.
Mediterranean prices were barely changed. Business in all ports was very thin, suppliers said.
Egyptian prices were similarly unchanged. Supplies were sufficient in all main ports.
In Durban, prices rose with dealers saying they would be tight for the next 10 days after oil companies had oversold.
